monomania.definition: n. a mania restricted to one thing or idea
monomania.translation:
n. 狂热, 偏执狂
[医] 单狂, 偏狂

monomaniac.definition: n. a person suffering from monomania
monomaniac.translation:
n. 狂热者, 偏执狂者
[医] 单狂者, 偏狂者, 单狂的, 偏狂的

monomaniacal.definition: s. obsessed with a single subject or idea
monomaniacal.translation: a. 狂热的, 偏执狂的

monomer.definition: n. a simple compound whose molecules can join together to form polymers

monomerous.definition:
a. Composed of solitary parts, as a flower with one sepal,
   one petal, one stamen, and one pistil.
a. Having but one joint; -- said of the foot of certain
   insects.

monomers.definition: n. a simple compound whose molecules can join together to form polymers

monometallic.definition: a. containing one atom of metal in the molecule
monometallic.translation:
a. 使用单金属的, 单(金属)本位制的
[医] 含一种金属[原子]的

monometallism.definition:
n. The legalized use of one metal only, as gold, or
   silver, in the standard currency of a country, or as a standard of
   money values. See Bimetallism.
monometallism.translation:
n. 单(金属)本位制
[经] 单本位制

monometallist.definition:
n. One who believes in monometallism as opposed to
   bimetallism, etc.
monometallist.translation: n. 单(金属)本位制论者

monometer.definition: n. A rhythmic series, consisting of a single meter.

monomethyl oxalate.translation: [化] 草酸一甲酯; 乙二酸一甲酯

monomethylin.translation: [化] 甘油-α-一甲醚; 单甲甘油醚; 一甲灵

monomethylxanthine.translation: [医] 一甲基黄嘌呤, 杂黄嘌呤

monometric.translation: a. 单音步诗行的；【晶体学】等轴的

monomial.definition:
n. A single algebraic expression; that is, an expression
   unconnected with any other by the sign of addition, substraction,
   equality, or inequality.
a. Consisting of but a single term or expression.
monomial.translation:
a. 单项的, 单个词的
n. 单项式, 单个词的

monomicrobic.translation: [医] 单微生物的, 一种细菌的

monomolecular.translation:
a. 单分子的
[医] 单分子的

monomolecular reaction.translation:
[化] 单分子反应
[医] 单分子反应

monomorium.translation: [网络] 小家蚁属；单家蚁属；门外汉

monomorium pharaonis.translation: [网络] 小黄家蚁；小黄单家蚁；法老蚁

monomorph.translation:
n. 单晶(形)物
a. 单晶的

monomorphemic.definition: a consisting of only one morpheme

monomorphic.translation:
[化] 单形的; 单形体
[医] 单形的

monomorphism.translation:
[计] 单一同态
[医] 单形[态]

monomorphous.definition:
a. Having but a single form; retaining the same form
   throughout the various stages of development; of the same or of an
   essentially similar type of structure; -- opposed to dimorphic,
   trimorphic, and polymorphic.
monomorphous.translation:
[化] 单形的; 单形体
[医] 单形的

monomotor.translation: 单电动机; 单发动机

monomoy.translation: n. 莫诺莫伊式破浪艇

monomphalus.definition:
n. A form of double monster, in which two individuals are
   united by a common umbilicus.

monomyaria.definition:
n.pl. An order of lamellibranchs having but one muscle for
   closing the shell, as the oyster.

monomyoplegia.translation: [医] 单肌麻痹, 单肌瘫[痪]

monomyth.translation: [网络] 单一神话；英雄之旅；英雄的旅程
